cleanIntro:
The Axe Cleaver is Bul Armory's striker-fired 9mm on the AXE platform. It has no conventional manual safety: a trigger safety lever in the face of the trigger, a firing pin safety and a drop safety, and the extractor stands proud of the slide when a round is chambered.

The field strip is Bul's own, from the AXE owner's manual, whose photographs are of this very model: clear the pistol, release the striker with one trigger press, ease the slide back about 3 mm, pull the slide lock down on both sides and run the slide off the front. The recoil spring assembly and the barrel then lift out of the slide. Bul stops there.

The manual prints no cleaning or lubrication instructions, so the checklist below names the parts the strip leaves in your hands and goes no further than the book does.

steps.title: Magazine out first
steps.action: Point the pistol in a safe direction and keep your finger off the trigger. Press the magazine catch and take the magazine out of the grip before you touch the slide.
steps.prose: Bul's disassembly must be done in its own order, and the magazine comes out first. Work the slide with a magazine still seated and you only feed a fresh round into the chamber. The AXE has no conventional manual safety, so nothing else stands between a chambered round and a trigger press.
steps.quote: Remove the magazine by pressing the magazine catch (19)
steps.cite: BUL ARMORY AXE C / FS Owner's manual (Cleaver / Hatchet / Tomahawk) — UNKNOWN — read off the manual's own pages — DISASSEMBLY, Step 1, p.14
steps.warn: Your AXE pistol does not have a conventional manual safety and it will fire if the trigger is pulled when there is a cartridge loaded in the chamber.

steps.title: Slide fully back to throw out any round
steps.action: Hold the pistol in your firing hand, finger off the trigger. With your other hand, grasp the rear of the slide and pull it fully back to eject any cartridge in the chamber.
steps.prose: All the way back, in one stroke: a short pull can draw a cartridge part way and let it fall back into the chamber. Keep your fingers clear of the ejection port.
steps.quote: grasp the rear portion of the slide with your other hand and pull the slide (1) fully back to eject any cartridge that may be in the chamber.
steps.cite: BUL ARMORY AXE C / FS Owner's manual (Cleaver / Hatchet / Tomahawk) — UNKNOWN — read off the manual's own pages — DISASSEMBLY, Step 2, p.14

steps.title: Lock the slide open
steps.action: With the slide fully back, push up on the slide stop lever and let the slide come forward slowly until it catches and stays open.
steps.prose: Ease it forward rather than letting go: the lever needs the slide to come onto it gently to hold. If the slide runs home, pull it back and try again.
steps.quote: Lock the slide in the rearward position by pushing up on the slide stop lever (27) and slowly release the slide from the fully rearward position until it locks in the open position.
steps.cite: BUL ARMORY AXE C / FS Owner's manual (Cleaver / Hatchet / Tomahawk) — UNKNOWN — read off the manual's own pages — DISASSEMBLY, Step 3, p.15

steps.title: Look and feel: chamber and magazine well empty
steps.action: With the slide locked back, look into the chamber and the magazine well, then check both with a fingertip. No cartridge may remain in either.
steps.prose: Bul asks for both the look and the touch, and the next steps depend on it: the slide only comes off after a trigger press. If you are not certain, lock it open and check again.
steps.quote: both visually and physically (Picture 19) inspect both the chamber and the magazine well of the pistol to be sure that no cartridges remain in the firearm.
steps.cite: BUL ARMORY AXE C / FS Owner's manual (Cleaver / Hatchet / Tomahawk) — UNKNOWN — read off the manual's own pages — DISASSEMBLY, Step 4, p.15

steps.title: Let the slide go forward
steps.action: Release the slide so it returns fully forward, either by pressing the slide stop lever down or by drawing the slide fully back with your other hand and letting it go.
steps.prose: Keep the muzzle pointed somewhere safe as it closes; the next step is a trigger press.
steps.quote: Release the slide to return it to the forward/closed position by either pressing the slide stop lever down or grasping the rear portion of the slide with your other hand and pulling the slide fully back and then release it.
steps.cite: BUL ARMORY AXE C / FS Owner's manual (Cleaver / Hatchet / Tomahawk) — UNKNOWN — read off the manual's own pages — DISASSEMBLY, Step 5, p.15

steps.title: Muzzle safe, one trigger press
steps.action: With the muzzle pointed in a safe direction, press the trigger once and keep it at the rear. The slide cannot come off the AXE unless the trigger is in its rearmost position.
steps.prose: Only on a pistol you have just seen and felt empty, magazine out. The trigger safety lever in the face of the trigger has to go down with the trigger, so press squarely.
steps.quote: With the muzzle of your firearm pointed to a safe direction pull the trigger. (The trigger must be in the rearmost position to remove the slide)
steps.cite: BUL ARMORY AXE C / FS Owner's manual (Cleaver / Hatchet / Tomahawk) — UNKNOWN — read off the manual's own pages — DISASSEMBLY, Step 6, p.16

steps.title: Take the takedown grip
steps.action: Hold the pistol in your firing hand with your fingers across the top of the rear of the slide, just in front of the rear sight, and your thumb on the rear of the frame.
steps.prose: This grip is what lets you draw the slide back a few millimetres in the next step without moving it so far that the trigger resets.
steps.quote: Hold your AXE pistol with your firing hand and with your fingers across the top of the rear of the slide in front of the rear sight and your thumb on the rear of the frame
steps.cite: BUL ARMORY AXE C / FS Owner's manual (Cleaver / Hatchet / Tomahawk) — UNKNOWN — read off the manual's own pages — DISASSEMBLY, Step 7, p.16

steps.title: Slide back about 3 mm, and hold it
steps.action: Using your fingers, draw the slide back about 1/8 in. (3 mm) and hold it there.
steps.prose: A little is enough. Draw it too far and the trigger resets forward; if that happens, point the muzzle somewhere safe and press the trigger again before you go on.
steps.quote: Using your fingers, retract the slide (1) about 1/8 in. / 3mm and hold it in this position
steps.cite: BUL ARMORY AXE C / FS Owner's manual (Cleaver / Hatchet / Tomahawk) — UNKNOWN — read off the manual's own pages — DISASSEMBLY, Step 8, p.17
steps.warn: If you pull the slide too far to the rear, it will reset the pistol's trigger to the forward position.

steps.title: Pull the slide lock down on both sides
steps.action: With the thumb and index finger of your other hand, pull the slide lock down on both sides of the frame and keep it there.
steps.prose: The slide lock is the small part above the front of the trigger guard, reachable from either side. Both sides have to come down together.
steps.quote: Using the thumb and index finger of your non firing hand, pull the slide lock (21) down on both sides
steps.cite: BUL ARMORY AXE C / FS Owner's manual (Cleaver / Hatchet / Tomahawk) — UNKNOWN — read off the manual's own pages — DISASSEMBLY, Step 9, p.17

steps.title: Slide forward and off the frame
steps.action: Still holding the slide lock down, push the slide forward and off the front of the frame.
steps.prose: If the slide will not move, do not force it: let go, check that the trigger is still to the rear, and start again from the 3 mm draw.
steps.quote: While holding the slide lock down, push the slide forward and off of the frame
steps.cite: BUL ARMORY AXE C / FS Owner's manual (Cleaver / Hatchet / Tomahawk) — UNKNOWN — read off the manual's own pages — DISASSEMBLY, Step 10, p.17

steps.title: Recoil spring assembly out
steps.action: Turn the slide over. Press the recoil spring assembly toward the front of the slide while lifting its rear end up, and take it out of the slide.
steps.prose: The spring is still under some load, so keep your thumb on it as it comes up. Note which end sat where: the small end goes back into the front of the slide.
steps.quote: Press the recoil spring assembly (3) toward the front of the slide while pulling it up to remove it from the slide
steps.cite: BUL ARMORY AXE C / FS Owner's manual (Cleaver / Hatchet / Tomahawk) — UNKNOWN — read off the manual's own pages — DISASSEMBLY, Step 11, p.18

steps.title: Barrel out by its locking cams
steps.action: Hold the barrel by its locking cams, the lugs under the chamber. Lift it, push it toward the front of the slide, then pull it up and toward the rear to take it out.
steps.prose: Forward first, then up and back: the barrel will not lift straight out.
steps.quote: Holding the barrel by the barrel locking cams, lift it and push it toward the front of the slide and then pull it up and toward the rear to remove it from the slide
steps.cite: BUL ARMORY AXE C / FS Owner's manual (Cleaver / Hatchet / Tomahawk) — UNKNOWN — read off the manual's own pages — DISASSEMBLY, Step 12, p.18

steps.title: Field strip complete: Bul stops here
steps.action: That is the field strip: frame, slide, recoil spring assembly and barrel. Bul Armory takes the pistol no further for cleaning.
steps.prose: The firing pin, extractor, slide cover plate and everything inside the frame stay where they are. Bul's book goes straight from here to reassembly.
steps.quote: Your AXE pistol is now disassembled (field stripped) and ready to be cleaned.
steps.cite: BUL ARMORY AXE C / FS Owner's manual (Cleaver / Hatchet / Tomahawk) — UNKNOWN — read off the manual's own pages — DISASSEMBLY, Step 13, p.19
steps.warn: Never modify or alter your Bul Armory firearm as this may affect the safety and reliability of your firearm and may cause serious injury to yourself and others.

deepAbsentReason: Bul Armory's AXE owner's manual ends at the field strip. After the barrel comes out of the slide it says "Your AXE pistol is now disassembled (field stripped) and ready to be cleaned." (p.19) and goes straight on to reassembly. It gives no firing pin, extractor or frame procedure, so this guide has no deep lane.

cleaning.name: BARREL & BORE
tasks: Bore looked through for anything lodged in it: mud, water, snow or any other object
⛔ Never shoot with anything in the bore
Locking cams wiped clean: you hold the barrel by them to take it out and put it back

cleaning.name: SLIDE
tasks: Slide wiped clean inside, along its rails and at the front where the recoil spring assembly seats
Firing pin, extractor and slide cover plate stay in the slide: Bul's field strip does not take them out

cleaning.name: RECOIL SPRING ASSEMBLY
tasks: Wiped clean as one assembly; it comes out and goes back in whole

cleaning.name: FRAME
tasks: Frame rails and the slide lock wiped clean
Trigger mechanism housing and its pins stay in the frame

reassembly: Hold the barrel by its locking cams and put it into the slide by pushing it down and in.

Recoil spring assembly: small end into the indentation at the front of the slide, then press the other end toward the front of the slide to compress the spring and push it down until its large end rests in the second (semi-circular) notch on the barrel locking cams.

Frame in your firing hand, finger off the trigger and outside the trigger guard. Set the slide on top of the frame in front of the slide rails and push it back until the slide lock snaps up and locks it in place. That is where Bul's reassembly ends.
fncheck: Magazine out, chamber empty, muzzle in a safe direction. Draw the slide fully back and let it go several times: it should run back and return fully forward without catching. Pull it back, push up on the slide stop lever and ease the slide onto it until it locks open, then press the lever down and let the slide close. With the slide back on, look at the extractor: on an empty chamber it lies flat against the slide, and Bul's book says it stands proud of the slide when a round is chambered. Bul's manual prints no further function check.
